# {{module-name}}  

This module creates a private S3 bucket. It has versioning enabled and the contents are encrypted at rest using SSE AES256 (Server-Side Encryption with AES-256).

Note: In the current verison of the module, the bucket has no Life Cycle Policy and no Access Logging enabled.
